items.title: Harold Christophe Interview, 1961-08-01
items.q: Never did see the music to this. By Hank Williams.

ctx.x: So I would try to keep up with everything, you know. You know. So I got a lot of music back there yet. So I, they fellas come, they come to me. But I'll keep everything in music. I'll go buy music. Or we keep all kind of music, you see. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Or we would keep it. So anything that would come up. Let's see this jambalaya. Yeah, jambalaya.
Yeah, jambalaya. Yeah, jambalaya. Yeah. Never did see the music to this. By Hank Williams. Right. I never knew who it was by.
Yeah. So I got a lot of more back there. That's with the hillbilly singer then, isn't it?
